briefdescription.para: Iteratively inline hot callsites of a function.

detaileddescription.para: Iteratively traverse all callsites of the function F, so as to find out callsites with corresponding inline instances.

For such callsites,
If it is hot enough, inline the callsites and adds callsites of the callee into the caller. If the call is an indirect call, first promote it to direct call. Each indirect call is limited with a single target.
If a callsite is not inlined, merge the its profile to the outline version (if sample-profile-merge-inlinee is true), or scale the counters of standalone function based on the profile of inlined instances (if sample-profile-merge-inlinee is false).
Later passes may consume the updated profiles.
